summary_1line: Sati tests Rama, is rebuked, later humiliated by Daksha and immolates herself at his sacrifice, prompting Shiva to create Virabhadra to destroy the yajna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sati, surrounded by shocked sages and blazing ritual fires, leaps into the sacrificial flames after denouncing her father Daksha.
Shiva tears a braid from his matted hair and hurls it onto a mountain, from which the fierce thousand‑armed warrior Virabhadra erupts.
Rama reveals his universal form to Sati, his body containing suns, gods, and countless beings shining in cosmic radiance.
